div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://openanimalnutrition.org/fhir/animal-nutrition/CodeSystem/adequacy-interpretation defines the following codes:

Below a minimum set by the applied standard, including one raised for a caloric restriction or by the AAFCO dry matter factor, and the arginine and large-breed puppy calcium minimums the source template computes from a standard's own rule. Whether a value below a minimum that the source template supplies or computes otherwise is deficient is an open point. Proposed, pending ratification.

Above an authoritative maximum (maxProvenance authoritative), and not below a minimum set by the applied standard, including one raised for a caloric restriction or by the AAFCO dry matter factor, as stated on the Decile Basis and Band Computation page. Not used above conditional, template-set or derived-provisional maximums. Proposed, pending ratification.

description.value: Per-nutrient and overall interpretations of a diet's nutrient levels against the applied requirement standard. The rules for `deficient` and `excess` are stated, proposed and pending ratification, on the [Decile Basis and Band Computation](band-computation.html) page.

definition.value: Below a minimum set by the applied standard, including one raised for a caloric restriction or by the AAFCO dry matter factor, and the arginine and large-breed puppy calcium minimums the source template computes from a standard's own rule. Whether a value below a minimum that the source template supplies or computes otherwise is deficient is an open point. Proposed, pending ratification.

Above an authoritative maximum (maxProvenance `authoritative`), and not below a minimum set by the applied standard, including one raised for a caloric restriction or by the AAFCO dry matter factor, as stated on the [Decile Basis and Band Computation](band-computation.html) page. Not used above conditional, template-set or derived-provisional maximums. Proposed, pending ratification.
